newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Venecemos to expand cement production.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Venecemos to expand cement production.

text.p: Venezuelan cement company Vencemos, a subsidiary of Mexican cement giant Cemex, is to invest 12 billion bolivars ($26 million) in expanding its three million tonnes per year Pertigalete plant, the company said.
"We are expanding to take advantage of Latin America's rapid economic integration and the multiple opportunities of Mercosur," said company President Francisco Garza in a press release.
Garza said the expanded production was primarily aimed at Brazilian and Peruvian markets, but did not provide figures.
